messages.subject: README banner added; all acceptance checks pass
messages.body: Added a single plain-prose banner paragraph beneath the existing H1 title in README.md, leaving the title byte-for-byte unchanged and touching no other file. Grounded the purpose wording in orca-companion.json, which shows this fixture exercises mixed-harness orchestration (command-code coordinator directing qwen-code workers, one work package, dependency changes disabled), and a scripted check confirmed title preservation, single-heading structure, prose-only rendering, one paragraph, and the case-insensitive IP-04/mixed/Controller keywords, all passing. Nothing is left outstanding: the change is uncommitted and the OpenSpec task checkboxes were deliberately left untouched per the design non-goal on the planning tree, leaving commit and task-tick to the finalizer.
